claude_proposed_widenings.name: trigger-bound non-reaction magic-item ability family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines ordinary charge-cast access and a reaction-shaped reflection with a third property that triggers on a failed save but does not spend a Reaction. No existing MagicItemMechanics family can encode a triggered, cooldown-bound resolution override that is not itself a reaction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_triggering_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even with a trigger-bound family, the current effect surface has no way to replace the outcome of the triggering saving throw after it has failed. This is not a bonus, reroll, or reflection; it is a direct failed-to-successful save conversion.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can turn your failed save into a successful one"
